panel.axis.1.name: Tiller Handle
panel.axis.1.note: tiller handle (rotates about the hub, scale RH 75 / LH 75)

panel.button.1.name: PEDAL DISC
panel.button.1.note: PEDAL DISC button on the hub, printed label

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), Airbus-style nose wheel steering tiller unit seen from the front and above: S-shaped tiller handle on a round scale (RH 75 ... 0 ... LH 75), PEDAL DISC push button on the hub
mappingSource: catalog: WinCtrl Steering Handwheel Left/Right 1.0 manuals (https://eu.winctrl.com/static/ipfs/QmUio6d7HvAeeYGSxhBs7RNaUM4waaRvRhv2nvTzo1y3Ri, https://eu.winctrl.com/static/ipfs/QmcW5ZWJhzpvm8UcnrQeHcZfyxh9w6hYv4RFaN9uQZYbKu); the manuals give no axis letter or button number, so the parts have no inputs; the controls themselves are unmistakable (printed PEDAL DISC, one rotating tiller)
note: The tiller axis marker sits on the tiller handle (the rotating part); the PEDAL DISC marker on the printed button cap. Left and right units have the same parts; this photo is one of them.
